parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the main door panel of the Door Set, typically made of wood. It is a rectangular flat component that fits within the frame.
parts.Functional_description: The door serves as the movable barrier that opens and closes to allow or restrict access through the doorway.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing it to swing open or closed.

parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the Door Set, made of wood. It provides structural support and defines the boundary for the door.
parts.Functional_description: The frame supports the door, holds the hinges, and ensures proper alignment and stability of the door assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or doorway structure.
